description: This file implements an Active Record pattern for database interaction, extending the ADOdb library with classes and functions for managing database records, relationships, caching, and error handling.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_DB
classes.description: Represents a database connection and its associated tables within the active record system.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_Table
classes.description: Holds metadata about a database table, including fields, keys, and relationships.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_Record
classes.description: Main class implementing the Active Record pattern, managing individual database records, relationships, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: ADODB_SetDatabaseAdapter
methods.description: Associates a database connection with an internal index for active record management.

methods.name: UseDefaultValues
methods.description: Static method to toggle default value usage for new records.

methods.name: SetDatabaseAdapter
methods.description: Static method to set the database adapter for active record classes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing an active record object with table, primary keys, and database connection.

methods.name: UpdateActiveTable
methods.description: Loads and caches table metadata, including fields and primary keys.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a record from the database based on a where clause.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Inserts or updates the current record in the database.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the database.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the existing record in the database.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the current record from the database.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Retrieves an array of records matching a condition.

methods.name: Replace
methods.description: Replaces or inserts a record based on primary key.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Handles errors, logs message, and optionally throws.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error number.

methods.name: DB
methods.description: Retrieves the database connection object.

methods.name: TableInfo
methods.description: Returns metadata about the current table.

methods.name: Reload
methods.description: Reloads the current record from the database.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets object properties from a database row.

methods.name: LastInsertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID for auto-increment fields.

methods.name: doQuote
methods.description: Quotes a value for use in SQL queries.

methods.name: GenWhere
methods.description: Generates a WHERE clause based on primary keys.

methods.name: LoadRelations
methods.description: Lazy loads related records based on relationships.

methods.name: nameQuoter
methods.description: Quotes table and column names according to configuration.
